story_overview: In a cluttered hospital corridor, Arthur and Omar stand over a man who lies tied and gagged on the floor, suggesting an intense interrogation. The story later shifts to a study where characters including Arthur, Eleanor, and Martin view images and video calls on a laptop, showing loved ones like Lila at a Thai temple.

video_prompts:
the captive man: A pale, unshaven man with hollow eyes wears a flimsy, open-backed hospital gown.
Arthur: Middle-aged man with short light-brown hair, wearing a brown polo shirt.
Omar: Man with short, dark, styled hair, wearing a light blue medical uniform with a white-trimmed collar.
The Hospital Corridor: A cluttered hospital storage room with metal shelving and cardboard boxes, opening into a bright, sterile institutional hallway with vinyl flooring and overhead fluorescent light fixtures, adjacent to a public waiting area with rows of chairs.
the metal basin with water: A round, silver-colored metal basin filled with clear water, containing a damp, white cloth.

In the middle of The Hospital Corridor, a man wearing the dark jacket lies tied and gagged on the floor. Arthur and Omar stand over the captive man. Omar, wearing the light blue scrubs, kneels and dips a cloth into the metal basin with water which rests on the captive's chest, while Arthur adjusts his firm grip on the man's foot.

the red plaid shirt: Long-sleeved, collared, button-front shirt with a red and black plaid pattern.

video_prompts:
The Wood-Paneled Study: A room with wood-paneled walls and an open laptop.
the small glass bottle: Small, clear glass bottle.
the rocks glass: Short, wide, cylindrical rocks glass made of clear glass with a thick, heavy base.
Close-up in The Wood-Paneled Study, Arthur sits in front of the open laptop, with the small glass bottle visible. He holds the empty small glass bottle upside down over the rocks glass, trying in vain to pour out the last drops.

the worn leather sofa: A low-profile, rectangular-bodied three-seater sofa upholstered in worn, dark brown leather with a cracked texture, featuring blocky armrests and two flat seat cushions.

Arthur sits on the worn leather sofa and pours the clear liquid from the small glass bottle into the rocks glass. His gaze is fixed on the open laptop, which rests on a table in front of him. Omar stands nearby, watching Arthur as his jaw tightens.

Eleanor: Older woman with short white hair, wearing a blue floral top and a beige cardigan.
Sophie: Woman.
The Golden Pagoda: A complex of ornate Thai temples featuring multi-tiered, steeply-pitched roofs with gilded spires, white stucco walls, intricate carvings, and decorative, colorful mirrored tiles.

Over-the-shoulder view of Arthur in The Wood-Paneled Study. He lifts the rocks glass to take a drink while looking at the open laptop. On the laptop screen, Eleanor and Sophie are on a video call, smiling and talking, with the temples of The Golden Pagoda visible behind them.
Arthur stares intently at the screen of the open laptop, his eyes scanning the content as he holds the rocks glass.

Lila: Woman with a flower in her hair.

Eleanor sits in the dimly lit The Wood-Paneled Study, looking at a photo on the laptop with temple photo. A faint smile touches her lips as she gazes at the image of Lila smiling warmly with the temples of The Golden Pagoda in the background.

the damask wallpaper: Cream-colored, matte-finish wallpaper with a subtle, repeating damask pattern in a slightly darker tan hue.
the vintage brass lamp: Vintage table lamp with a tarnished, golden-brass finish, featuring a round, tiered base, a slender curved neck, and a pleated, bell-shaped cream fabric lampshade.

A medium close-up of Martin sitting in The Study at night. A pained, emotional smile forms on his face as he looks at the screen of the open laptop, which is just out of frame. The background features the vintage brass lamp.

the piece of black tape: Small, rectangular piece of black electrical tape.
the temple video footage: Video footage showing a woman with a flower in her hair at a Thai temple.

Over-the-shoulder shot in The Wood-Paneled Study. Omar places the piece of black tape over the webcam of the open laptop. The screen of the open laptop brightly illuminates the dim room, displaying the temple video footage of Lila. Eleanor stands behind Omar, leaning in slightly to get a better look at the laptop screen.
